summary: Frontend-only RETEST of the 6 consistency defects from iteration_28 (Taxable Lifetime Gifts). Logged in via Master PIN on the public URL, modeled a taxable gift on Plan Inputs (year 2030), and inspected the Estate tab callout + exemption gauge, and the Client Report Unified Credit page (cr-unified-credit-toggle) and Basis Step-Up page (cr-basis-toggle, which is what actually renders cr-page-basis-stepup). Ran the default (under-exclusion) scenario AND a bumped large-estate scenario ($60M x2 taxable accounts, $20M gift) to check both the $0 and positive-savings regimes. RESULT: all 6 fixes (FIX1-FIX6) verified PASS. FIX1: basis table now foots exactly — Roth $8,882,619 + Taxable $0 + Trad $0 + Gift $23,325,997 = total nominal $32,208,616; after-tax $8,882,619 + $18,144,469 = $27,027,089; drag $5,181,527 (16.1%) = nominal - after. FIX2: Unified Credit 'tax saved' = $0 in the under-exclusion scenario, matching the Estate tab's +$0 (no longer the old $9.8M contradiction), and turns positive ($61.7M) when the estate is over the ceiling. FIX3: narrative now reads 'the estate delivers $12,453,645 plus the $18,144,469 family gift pot' and the with-total ($30,598,114) >= estate-only with figure. FIX4: estate-gift-impact notax/withtax/saved internally consistent in both scenarios (noTax>=withTax, saved == noTax-withTax, saved>=0; large estate $506,263,042 / $450,108,178 / +$56,154,863). FIX5: Plan Inputs block reads 'Total taxable gifts (requested)' plus the capped-at-available note. FIX6: headroom shows $67,429,467 with no spurious minus under the ceiling, and '+$1,105,270,446' under the 'Estate exposed above ceiling' label when over. No backend testing performed (explicitly out of scope). Two NEW minor cross-page numeric inconsistencies found in the large-estate case (see below) — neither is a regression of the 6 fixes.

ui_bugs.issue: MINOR/NEW: the two views disagree on the combined shelter for the same plan. Estate tab gauge shows 'Fed excl Y1 + Y2 combined = $79,883,112' (full exclusions, ignoring that the lifetime taxable gifts already consumed part of the first decedent's exclusion), while the Unified Credit page correctly computes shelter = Y2 exclusion + DSUE net of gifts = $69,883,112. Consider deducting adjusted_gifts_first_death/_second_death from the gauge's combinedAvailable (or footnoting it) so the two documents agree.

MINOR/NEW: in the large-estate run the page's simplified flat-40% model gives tax WITHOUT $515,830,345 / WITH $454,108,178 / saved $61,722,166, while the Estate tab engine (incl. state tax) reports $506,263,042 / $450,108,178 / +$56,154,863 for the same plan — same sign and same order of magnitude, but a ~$5.6M (9%) headline gap between two pages of the same deliverable. Also the fine print hardcodes 'Within-exclusion estates show $0 of cash tax saved' even when the estate is far above the exclusion, which reads oddly there.

rca_of_the_issue: Remaining gauge-vs-report shelter gap: Estate.jsx builds combinedAvailable from the raw Y1+Y2 federal exclusions, while UnifiedCreditPage.jsx derives DSUE as exclY1 - adjusted_gifts_first_death, so lifetime taxable gifts reduce the report's shelter but not the Estate gauge's. Cosmetic/consistency only; underlying tax figures come from the backend engine on the Estate tab.
